name: Improved Channel Spirit (Mythic)
body:
Your bonded spirit taps into your mythic energies and multiplies its power.

Prerequisite(s): Improved Channel Spirit.

Benefit(s): You gain spirit abilities granted by your chosen spirit as a medium with a level equal to your character level -2. For that spirit’s minor power, use your full character level to determine its effect; for all other spirit powers, treat your medium level as your character level –2.
